summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of idempotency fix for POST /api/payments. PRIMARY TEST: 6 parallel payments with SAME idempotency_key correctly created exactly 1 payment record (not 6), with paid_amount = 300,000 (not 1,800,000). All regression tests passed including overpay guard, cancelled booking payment rejection, payment_status derivation, DP-gate, and negative add_on validation. Data integrity gate passed all 35 invariants (INV-1 through INV-26).
passed_tests: PRIMARY: 6 parallel POST /api/payments with SAME idempotency_key → exactly 1 payment record created, paid_amount = 300,000 (not 1,800,000)
Sequential replay with SAME idempotency_key → still 1 record, paid_amount unchanged
Backward compatibility: POST without idempotency_key creates distinct records (2 payments without keys → 2 records)
Distinct idempotency_keys: 2 payments with different keys → 2 records created
REGRESSION: Overpay guard returns 400 'melebihi sisa' when payment exceeds remaining amount
REGRESSION: Payment on cancelled booking returns 400 with 'dibatalkan' message
REGRESSION: Payment status derivation correct (belum_bayar → dp → lunas)
REGRESSION: DP-gate works (hold → confirmed after DP payment with require_dp=True)
REGRESSION: Negative add_on returns 422 validation error
Data integrity gate: All 35 invariants passed (INV-1 through INV-26)
